title: workitems.json
description: Manifest describing a tree of Azure DevOps work items to create. Structural rules only: uniqueness of `id`, parent resolution, cycles and legal parent/child type pairs are graph-level rules checked in code, not here.

organization.description: ADO organization name, e.g. `contoso`. Name only, not the full URL.

namespace.description: Scopes the identity tag: `wi:<namespace>/<id>`. Use it when several manifests target the same project and might reuse an `id`.

defaults.description: Values inherited by every item that does not override them. Inheritance is per key; `tags` are merged, not replaced.

items.description: The work items, as a flat array. Nesting is expressed only through `parent`.

path.description: Area or iteration path, backslash-separated and prefixed with the project name, e.g. `MonProjet\MES`.

items.description: A tag. `;` is ADO's tag separator and would silently split the tag in two.

id.description: Stable identifier within the manifest (and within the `namespace`, if set). Never a generated UUID.

parent.description: The `id` of another item in the same manifest. Absent or null means a root item. Never an ADO work item ID.

parent_ado_id.description: An existing ADO work item ID, to hang a new subtree under something already on the board.

description.description: Maps to System.Description, except for Bug which maps to Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.ReproSteps.

order.description: Sorts this item among its siblings, ascending. Excluded from the content hash.

fields.description: ADO field reference name -> value, written verbatim. The escape hatch: values are deliberately unconstrained.
